title: a new catch, default or ?? that hides a failure the caller must see
question: Does a new catch, default or `??` hide a failure the caller must see?

explain.what: A model read the diff and found a new catch, default value or ?? that hides a failure the caller must see.
explain.why: A hidden failure lets the code go on as if the step worked; the real fault shows up later, far from its cause.
explain.fix: Let the failure reach the caller, or handle it and say in a comment what happens next. The second voice is in shadow: it warns only. Rate the finding (thumbs up or down) so its precision can be measured.

head.src/cfg.mjs:
export const port = c => c.port;
export const load = f => { try { return JSON.parse(f()); } catch { return {}; } };
